source_mapping.source_preservation: Exact item text and ID, parent section ID, original 180-second round prescription, rests, source URL and catalog hash. The heading demo is shared section context, not an exact clip for each focus.
source_mapping.fallback: Changed or ambiguous source lists remain whole. The existing 22 manual sections and 218 source-item steps remain intact.

completion_receipt.semantics: Session ended, not verified exercise adherence; voice cues are requests, not confirmed playback. Works with zero exchanges and without a model call.
completion_receipt.lineage: Explicit runtime origin, session ID, source version, parent section and source item IDs, segment exits and cue request IDs.
completion_receipt.privacy: No pose counts, landmarks, footage, transcripts or free-text reflection in v1 completion receipts. Separate pose telemetry remains opt-in.
completion_receipt.delivery: Phone stores a stable receipt and retries asynchronously. Server accepts duplicate identical input once and queues an MLflow event.

validation.failed_attempts: Initial integration build lost CocoaPods linkage after xcodegen; pod install restored it. New virtual-pad UI test first used the wrong Skip accessibility label and then queried the absent source title on a rest segment. Corrected focused UI test passed.

development_usage.coverage: Exposed per-response usage only; no hidden reasoning or full inference payload capture.

remaining_validation: No new completed physical-phone workout or phone-origin completion receipt was observed in this checkpoint. Cue audibility, movement recognition, and drill adherence remain unverified. Source program text remains English. Actual billed USD and equivalent estimates are unknown.
